scope: Guitar tab: Songs, Learn, Exercises (and practice/, which is Learn's implementation, and song/follow/, whose presentation files polish work needs). Excludes fretboard, tuner, vocal, home, social. The files in scripts/frozen-files.txt are frozen but still measured: GuitarFollow.css is not frozen and accounts for 32 of the hex literals.
note: The polish ratchet. Each metric may only move in its direction. Re-record with: node scripts/assert-baseline.mjs --write

untokenisedSheets.target: 0 — every in-scope sheet themes through tokens

appTestFiles.target: never drops — whole-app, so a guitar fix cannot break a vocal test

largestInScopeComponent.target: ~400 — GuitarSong.jsx is the outlier; split it along its section seams
